description: This file defines the RoundRobinSelector class, implementing a resource selection strategy using a round robin algorithm, for generic resources within the Orleans.Streams namespace.

classes.name: RoundRobinSelector<T>
classes.description: A class that selects resources using a round robin scheduling algorithm, maintaining internal state to track last selected resource.

methods.name: RoundRobinSelector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the selector with a collection of resources, shuffling them randomly and setting initial selection index.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Property returning the total number of resources.

methods.name: NextSelection
methods.description: Selects a list of new resources, avoiding duplicates with existing selections, using round robin logic.
